text: In this game, the only way forward is to kill your friend May.
May, Be Dead. A first-person walk through endless hexagonal rooms of memory.
The rooms borrow from theatre, film, literature and architecture.
The demo is about seven hundred megabytes, for Windows and Mac, in English and Simplified Chinese.
The full game has four chapters, due in December.
Worth a dip if you like your games strange and slow.
That's Demo Dip. A new Steam demo, every day.
